title: Genkan public evaluation reports
description:
Archive of public reports from Genkan, a personal-agent runtime project, and its evaluation work. Private runtime code, signed journals, and private input data are not released. The reports give aggregate results and hashes for private material; some public derived exports and synthetic development probes are included.

Reports in this archive:
- Pre-registered evaluation of agent identity under model and charter change: a negative result (2026-10-technical-report): consolidated technical report.
- Charter v1, v2a, and v2b under probe protocol v3 (2026-10-charter-series): three charter texts tested on two models.
- Probe spec v2 baseline and cross-model run (2026-10-probe-v2-cross-model): model-change comparison under one charter.
- Charter v1 identity-probe baseline (2026-10-charter-identity-probes): frozen baseline and live adoption.
- Verified Trust Experiment (2026-10-verified-trust): the main run had 2,000 items over 10 cycles and four lines; all 2,000 were verified, 0 failed. Rule A (call-based) ranked the lines by activity, not by honesty. At cycle 10 the cheater scored 62, the do-nothing line 60 and the honest line 59. No call was denied, so Rule A scores depend only on the number of allowed calls: the cheater made 2.44 calls per attempt, the do-nothing line 2.00, honest 1.95.

Code is MIT licensed; report text, figures, and data are CC BY 4.0 licensed.
